jobs.description:
What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

Help Write Our Next Chapter

As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Lead the implementation, configuration and continued development of Pandora’s Developer Portal, built on Port.io.

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

• Design engineering scorecards covering operational readiness, security, reliability, documentation and architecture standards.

• Establish and maintain Golden Paths that simplify and standardise software delivery.

• Drive adoption of self-service capabilities across development, deployment, observability and operational excellence.

• Integrate Port.io with platforms including GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Azure and Kubernetes.

• Build greater visibility into engineering health, service quality and operational readiness.

• Use DORA metrics, flow metrics and Developer Experience frameworks to support measurable improvements.

• Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and turn this into focused improvement initiatives.

• Influence engineering leaders and teams to adopt shared platform standards and self-service ways of working.

• Facilitate communities of practice and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

• Evaluate emerging developments across Developer Experience, Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.

What Makes You Shine:

You are passionate about improving the day-to-day experience of engineers and understand that great Developer Experience is about more than tooling. It brings together thoughtful platform design, automation, clear ownership, effective governance and a deep understanding of how developers work.

We would love to hear from you if you bring:

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms or a closely related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.

• Experience implementing or evolving a developer portal, software catalogue or comparable self-service engineering platform.

• Knowledge of software catalogue architecture, service ownership and engineering governance.

• Experience designing Golden Paths, engineering scorecards or reusable self-service capabilities.

• A strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud platforms, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience integrating engineering tools and platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, ServiceNow or observability solutions.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics, flow metrics or other approaches to measuring engineering effectiveness.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience with Port.io would be particularly valuable. However, we are also interested in people who have built relevant experience through comparable developer portals, Internal Developer Platforms or service catalogue technologies.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this opportunity excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

Crafting What’s Next, Together

You will join Pandora’s DevOps & Operational Excellence team within Digital & Technology and report to the Director of DevOps & Operational Excellence.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, Service Management and Cloud Platforms. You will have the opportunity to shape solutions across organisational boundaries and help create a more consistent, productive and developer-centred engineering environment.

This role is a Lead Engineer, individual contributor role.

The Impact You Will Make

Your impact will be visible through the adoption of the Developer Portal and Golden Paths, increased use of self-service platform capabilities, broader coverage of the software catalogue and clearer service ownership.

The role will also contribute to reducing developer onboarding time, strengthening engineering standards, improving developer satisfaction and reducing manual governance activities.

The Additional Sparkle

You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas. It’s a great base from which to help shape Pandora’s Developer Experience and influence how our engineering teams work globally.

Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

If you can see yourself improving how engineers build, deliver and operate technology, while helping Pandora advance its Platform Engineering and Operational Excellence journey, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Let’s Craft the Incredible

Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, helping people share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next

Join a fast-growing international MedTech company and take a central role in turning AI ambitions into practical, adopted solutions across the organisation.

Turn AI ambitions into practical business impact

Contura International has been named a Gazelle company two years in a row and has experienced significant growth over the past five years, increasing revenue fivefold and its number of employees tenfold.

As AI Lead, you will join Contura's IT & Projects organisation and report to the Head of IT.

In this newly established role, you will take ownership of the AI roadmap and use-case portfolio and help move AI initiatives from pilot to production.

Working across business and IT, you will drive adoption, build internal AI capability and ensure that initiatives create business value while meeting relevant quality and compliance requirements.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own and drive Contura's AI roadmap, use-case portfolio and implementation plan.

• Translate business needs into qualified use cases, requirements and solution proposals.

• Take successful AI and digital solutions from pilot into controlled production.

• Build internal AI capability through training, workshops and an AI community of champions and key users.

• Coordinate external specialists and contribute to pragmatic AI governance together with IT, Quality and Regulatory Affairs.

Business-minded AI profile with strong implementation skills

We are open regarding your professional background and previous job title. What matters most is your ability to understand business needs, turn them into relevant AI or digital solutions and create momentum from idea through implementation and adoption.

We imagine that you bring:

• Experience taking AI or digital solutions from pilot to production and driving user adoption.

• Experience translating business needs into solution proposals, requirements and priorities.

• Practical understanding of data foundations, data quality and integrations.

• Experience with AI and data solutions, preferably within the Microsoft ecosystem.

• Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to make AI understandable and relevant across the business.

You are pragmatic, curious and delivery-oriented and comfortable creating structure and direction in an area that is still developing. You work well across functions and combine a strategic perspective with practical execution and a clear focus on business outcomes.

Turn AI into lasting business capability

This is an opportunity to take a central role in how Contura develops and applies AI as the company continues its growth and digitalisation journey.

The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Fares Almas at fa@venaris.dk. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV.

Contura International

Contura is a fast-growing international MedTech company that develops, manufactures and commercialises innovative hydrogel-based products for treatment in areas including female urinary incontinence, orthopaedics and veterinary applications. The company has more than 20 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of therapeutic hydrogels and has experienced significant growth in recent years. Learn more about Contura at http://www.contura.dk/

Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections? Do you have a strong creative vision, exceptional sketching abilities, and a deep understanding of craftsmanship, materials, and the jewellery design process? Would you like to shape the future of Pandora's Modern Classics & Diamonds category by creating innovative designs that combine timeless elegance with modern expression?

Lead creative projects that define the future of Pandora's most iconic collections

As our new Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director to lead creative projects from initial concept generation through design execution and prototype development. Utilizing your strong creative skills, technical expertise, and deep understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will play a key role in developing compelling collections that inspire customers around the world.

Your Role

Design & Collection Development

• 
Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• 
Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs, and sketches that align with Pandora's brand identity.

• 
Lead individual design projects from initial research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• 
Propose original and future-thinking product ideas that support the strategic direction of the category.

• 
Ensure projects are developed and launched within agreed timelines and project requirements.

• 
Review and provide comprehensive feedback on CADs within agreed timeframes.

• 
Develop creative mood boards, concept presentations, creative sketches, and technical drawings to support product development.

• 
Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

• 
Review early prototypes and provide feedback ahead of formal prototype review sessions.

• 
Support prototype reviews and creative evaluations when required.

• 
Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques, and innovation opportunities.

• 
Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

• 
Ensure legal documentation and inspiration references are provided within agreed timelines.

• 
Maintain accurate design documentation, presentations, folders, and project records throughout the design process.

• 
Support and mentor Junior Designers, providing guidance on both creative and technical aspects of their work.

Research & Innovation

• 
Conduct research projects based on briefs from Creative Leadership.

• 
Participate in research trips to identify emerging trends, products, techniques, materials, and creative inspiration.

• 
Translate research findings into strong creative concepts and collection ideas.

• 
Contribute to the development of new concepts, innovation opportunities, and future category directions.

• 
Ensure all research, concept development, reviews, and launches are delivered according to agreed timelines and processes.

• 
Update design presentations with relevant concepts, sketches, and final designs throughout project development.

A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery Design

You might be the person we are looking for if you combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an eye for commercial product design. You are skilled at transforming inspiration into compelling jewellery concepts and are comfortable working across all stages of the design process, from initial idea generation to final product execution.

You understand how to balance innovation with brand consistency and have a proven ability to create products that strengthen and evolve an established global brand. You enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced international environment and thrive when bringing new ideas to life.

Requirements

• 
Extensive experience designing jewellery within a fashion, luxury, or jewellery brand.

• 
Strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches, and finished products.

• 
Proven experience leading design projects from concept to prototype.

• 
Advanced knowledge of jewellery design and manufacturing processes.

• 
Strong hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• 
Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• 
Ability to translate creative direction into commercially successful products.

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• 
Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• 
Proficiency in relevant design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

Important

Please include a portfolio showcasing your design work, creative process, technical skills, and collection development experience as part of your application.

Your New Team

As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate, ambitious, and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery. You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing, and Product Development.

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Did We Get Your Attention?

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become part of Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on an ongoing basis and therefore encourage you to submit your application at your earliest convenience. You can read more about Pandora on our corporate website Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• 
You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• 
You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• 
You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• 
You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• 
Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

• 
Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• 
Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• 
Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• 
Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• 
Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

• 
You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• 
You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• 
You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• 
You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• 
You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

• 
You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• 
Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• 
Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• 
Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• 
Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

• 
You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• 
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• 
You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• 
You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• 
You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• 
You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

• 
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• 
For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• 
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• 
Our working language is English.

We offer

• 
Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• 
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• 
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• 
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• 
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• 
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• 
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• 
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• 
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• 
Pension plan and private health insurance.

• 
Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?
Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.
We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

CHEMICAL ENGINEER

Help us develop cleaner, high-performance braking solutions

Would you like to join the world’s leading supplier of industrial braking solutions? Svendborg Brakes is looking for a skilled and motivated Chemical Engineer to join our Application Department. You will help develop organic brake pads and contribute to cleaner, safer and more reliable braking solutions. You do not need to be a brake-pad expert today, but you should be eager to develop your knowledge in this field.

Key responsibilities 

• Develop new friction materials for a wide range of applications.
• Lead technical discussions with suppliers and customers.
• Evaluate new raw materials and manufacturing processes against friction-performance requirements.
• Identify brake-pad components with a focus on environmental impact and regulatory compliance.
• Document components in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
• Develop test methods for new friction materials in cooperation with Test Center personnel.
• Prepare work instructions and production recipes for brake-pad manufacturing.
• Take a hands-on role in pilot production and support the transfer to full-scale production.
• Prepare reports and statistical analyses of particles and fumes generated during braking-system use.

 Qualifications 

• A degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science or a related field.
• Experience with material formulation is an advantage.
• Knowledge of rubber technology, plastics and inorganic materials.
• Knowledge of hazardous and restricted chemicals, including REACH requirements.
• Experience with product and environmental documentation, such as safety data sheets, is an advantage.
• Knowledge of good laboratory practice.
• Experience working within an ISO- or TS-based quality management system.
• Fluent spoken and written English. Danish or another language is an advantage.

 Personal qualities 

• Positive, persistent and open-minded.
• Proactive and able to turn ideas into action.
• Professional and comfortable working with colleagues at all levels of the organization.
• Practical, curious and motivated by technical problem-solving.

 What we offer 

• An exciting and independent role with varied responsibilities and testing activities in our expanded Test Center.
• An informal and collaborative working environment with strong opportunities for knowledge sharing.
• Good opportunities for personal and professional development.
• A competitive salary based on qualifications, pension, health insurance and an attractive canteen scheme.

 Interested? 

For further information, please contact Head of Test Center, Esben Rasmussen by telephone on +45 63 25 54 93.

If this position interests you, please submit your application and detailed CV through the application link as soon as possible.

Learn more at www.svendborg-brakes.com.

 Svendborg Brakes creates high growth for both customers and us by innovating, testing and delivering world-class braking solutions. We are value driven and customer focused, and we continuously strive for superior and unmatched quality in design, products, testing, certification and services. This makes us Global Leading Experts and the preferred and trusted provider in the field of intelligent braking solutions. Part of the Regal Rexnord Group www.regalrexnord.com.

Would you like to use data and technology to solve real challenges in logistics? Are you curious about Power BI, Power Apps, automation, simulation, or coding and motivated to see your work used in daily operations? Join our Digital Development team and gain practical experience creating solutions that support Arla’s warehouses, distribution activities, and dairies.

How will you make an impact

As a Student Assistant in Digital Development, you will help turn operational needs into practical, user-friendly digital solutions. Working closely with colleagues in warehouses, distribution, and dairies, you will contribute throughout the development journey; from understanding a challenge and creating a prototype to testing, implementation, documentation, and further improvement.

You will:

• Develop and improve Power BI reports, dashboards, and decision-support tools.

• Help build Power Apps and Power Automate solutions that simplify processes and reduce repetitive manual work.

• Support simulations, digital models, and prototypes that allow the team to test ideas before wider implementation.

• Use data, coding, and scripting to transform information, connect systems, and add useful functionality.

• Gather input from users, translate operational challenges into clear requirements, and test solutions with the people who will use them.

• Assist with maintaining, documenting, and continuously improving existing digital solutions.

• Be part of a small, dedicated team where your contributions truly make an impact.

This role is ideal for a student who enjoys experimenting with technology, solving practical problems, and developing ideas into tools that colleagues can use in their daily work. You are not expected to know every technology from day one; technical curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn are equally important.

What will make you successful

You are someone who is passionate about turning data and technology into practical tools that make a real difference for our operations. You think beyond reporting -  you focus on what decisions colleagues need to take, and how digital products can help them act earlier, faster, and smarter.

You thrive in the space between business and technology, where you translate operational challenges into intuitive, proactive, decision‑support solutions. You enjoy working with data, but you get most energy from seeing your tools in the hands of users and watching them improve the day‑to‑day execution.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Are currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor’s or master’s programme within areas such as IT, software development, data science, engineering, business intelligence, supply chain, logistics, or a comparable field.

• Expect to have at least one year remaining of your studies.

• Have some exposure to (or the motivation to learn):  o Power BI, data modelling, and visualising operational information. o Power Apps, Power Automate, or similar low-code technologies. o SQL, databases, APIs, and data integration. o Programming, scripting, automation, or simulation.

• Designing intuitive digital tools for technical and non-technical users.

• Have an interest in, or willingness to learn about, improvement methodologies such as Lean, Agile, or other continuous-improvement frameworks.

• Are curious, structured, and able to break down problems into clear digital requirements.

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical teams and enjoy gathering user input

• Are comfortable asking questions and constructively challenging assumptions while learning from experienced colleagues.

• Communicate clearly in Danish and English and can work approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility around exams and your studies.

And personally, you:

• Bring a proactive, learning‑oriented mindset.

• Ask the right questions and aren’t afraid to challenge “how we’ve always done it”.

• Enjoy iterating, testing, and improving digital tools with users.

• Want to see your work used in real operations, not just sitting in a report.

What do we offer?

You will gain hands-on experience developing digital solutions with visible impact on daily operations.  We offer close collaboration with operational users, opportunities to follow ideas from early concept through implementation, room to contribute your own perspectives, and professional development. The role is planned flexibly around your studies and gives you access to Arla’s student community.

We have a purpose for Good

At Arla, we strive to unlock the highest potential in each other while working together to create a sustainable future of dairy. We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organization and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. In order to succeed, we need to hire people with a sustainable mindset. Could this be you?

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Technical Solution Designer - Clinical Trial Mgmt & Clinical Trial Supply in IT
jobs.description:
Are you a Technical Solution Designer with deep understanding of Clinical Trial Management and Clinical Trial Supply? Do you think holistically, act with ambition, and find technical solutions to accelerate clinical trial oversight?

Can you design and implement configurations for SaaS applications to support trials?

If so, you may be our new T_echnical Solution Designer._

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our context

This position is based in our Global IT organization. In Global IT, we have spent the past five years building and maturing a product-driven organization. We operate with a strong focus on product management and lifecycle thinking, where long-lived teams take full ownership- from problem discovery to solution delivery and continuous improvement - ensuring we address real business needs.

Our structure combines clear leadership intent with empowered teams: each team member is supported by both a People Leader focused on development and a Functional Leader guiding strategy and delivery. We foster autonomy and self-organization to enable fast flow, clear accountability, and minimal dependencies.

The Clinical domain currently consists of three product teams and a data team, supporting our Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Clinical Data Management and Clinical Trial Supply functions.

We are seeking a passionate Technical Solution Designer who will be responsible for designing and implementing technical solutions to support CTM and CTS. Practically speaking, you will be the technical expert in how our CTMS, eTMF, and IRT are configured. All of these are SaaS solutions. When our SaaS solutions fall short, you will find ways to deliver functionality in collaboration with our Automation, Integration, AI and Analytics teams.

Together with the IT product team, you will ensure that the solutions, including the documentation packages we deliver, are GxP compliant and sustainable.

You will report to Simon Rønne Kümmel, Clinical Domain Lead, and Jakob Thrane, People Leader. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be to

• Design and implement technical configuration and solutions to support CTM and CTS.

• Engage with stakeholders to understand business needs.

• Either implement the configurations yourself, or work with the managed services provider or vendor to implement the configuration.

• Oversee system support and act as escalation point for tickets.

• Assist with documentation and validation of solutions.

• Be visionary in improving our CTM and CTS supply technical capabilities and suggest and implement improvements for automation, integration and seamless data flows.

• Ensure systems are in a validated state and are inspection-ready.

• Maintain operational oversight over vendors.

Qualifications and experience

You hold a relevant academic degree – preferably a Master’s degree, with a background as an Engineer, Technical Business Analyst, Configuration Manager or an equivalent technical role.

You have solid experience with eTMF and CTMS in a GxP context, minimum +3 years of relevant experience across complex organizations.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong understanding of Clinical Trial Management and Clinical Trial Supply and related systems.

• Experience working with SaaS vendors.

• Ability to connect people and create shared understanding and direction.

• Is good at collaborating with business in complex and ambiguous settings, handling conflicts constructively and helps groups move forward.

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be good at collaborating with business in complex and ambiguous settings, handling conflicts constructively, and helping groups move forward.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position in an entrepreneurial and international company with short decision paths. You will work with highly skilled colleagues and play a key role in shaping how Global IT delivers sustainable value to Ascendis Pharma and, ultimately, to patients.

Travel: 10-15 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Flexibility: Some of the Clinicial organization is located in the US, and meetings in the afternoon and evening will occur.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Jakob Monajemzadeh Thrane, People Leader, jmt@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website,

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

As the summer holiday period approaches, you may experience a longer response time than usual. We truly appreciate your patience and thank you for your understanding. We look forward to reviewing your application as soon as possible.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

**Location - Ballerup

**Your new role

jobs.description:
Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. Trackunit specializes in digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry. The construction industry is the least digitalized industry of all. This lack of digitalization has left construction far behind a global economy on the rise and placed the industry as one of the least productive industries too.

We are looking for an IoT Services Manager to own end-to-end customer-facing project management, and IoT technical account management for their region. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for device, fleet, and IoT solution health to our customer as a trusted technical advisor, guiding them from installation through fleet-health optimization and ongoing device lifecycle support.

With locations in Denmark, The UK and The Netherlands, we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations or remotely. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives on our career site.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• Technical account management or technical advisory experience in an IoT, telematics, or hardware environment.

• Comfortable consulting customer and interpreting fleet-health and technical data to advise customers and benchmark performance against peer accounts.

• Working knowledge of device and firmware management (CAN, MODbus, firmware/FOTA, BLE sensors) sufficient to guide configuration, validation, and troubleshooting.

• Experience in customer-facing project management, installation, or deployment operations.

• Strong organizational skills — comfortable working with multiple concurrent programs at once.

• Skilled at building trusted relationships with both customer technical stakeholders and internal sales, account, and support/engineering teams.

• Professional fluency in either one of the Nordics languages or Dutch, besides English.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted customer partnerships: Serve as the primary technical contact for IoT accounts, understand customer goals and document agreed solutions and priorities.

• Present insights and recommendations: Lead monthly fleet and device health reviews, translating technical findings into business impact, recommended actions and measurable outcomes for operational and executive audiences.

• Own technical configuration: Manage CAN/Modbus profiles, firmware—including FOTA—and device operating modes to keep customer fleets healthy and reporting accurately.

• Drive proactive fleet health: Monitor fleet and device health, investigate non-reporting devices, and proactively identify and resolve risks before they affect customer operations.

• Support quality deployments: Partner with deployment and technical teams to align requirements, validate installation quality and establish reliable data from day one.

• Lead technical escalations: Coordinate resolution across Support, Engineering and delivery teams, maintaining clear accountability, customer communication and follow-through.

• Enable adoption and growth: Guide customers on relevant IoT capabilities, partner with Sales and Customer Success on improvement opportunities, and bring customer feedback into product and service discussions.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

**The question is: Are you in?

**_Trackunit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

__Trackunit also prioritizes providing reasonable accommodations for qualified people with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let our People & Talents team know.

_**About Trackunit

**Trackunit is the leading operating data platform connecting people, assets, and processes in construction.

A global technology company connecting the construction industry - by orchestrating data and infrastructure - to build the most useful industry for the world.

We connect construction through one platform to create a living, evolving ecosystem that delivers data and insights to the off-highway sector. With more than 2 million assets connected and more than 2 billion data points collected each day, we use technology to eliminate downtime, improve safety, and help customers improve the bottom line in a sustainable, cost-effective way

As GLP QA Professional, you will help make sure non-clinical research at Novo is carried out to Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) standards. You will oversee studies, inspect internal and external work, and turn what you see into clear, practical recommendations that keep research reliable and moving. You will shape how quality is built into non-clinical processes, strengthening the foundation for treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You bring a balanced, practical quality mindset. You work systematically and independently, take initiative and stay flexible when priorities change. To succeed in this role, you have:

• Experience as a laboratory technician and relevant qualification, or a master’s degree in science, pharmacy, medicine or a similar field.

• Experience within GLP, for example from quality assurance, GLP-regulated work, non-clinical research or laboratory activities.

• Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and the ability to interpret and communicate regulatory and procedural requirements.

• Strong analytical and organisational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to work systematically and independently.

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build constructive relationships with internal colleagues and external Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

• Proficiency in written and spoken English, and confidence in communicating observations, recommendations and quality matters.

Desirable, but not essential:

Experience from industrial drug development.

What you’ll do

You will be the quality partner for GLP-regulated activities, helping colleagues and CROs meet requirements while keeping study quality and compliance protected.

• Perform quality oversight and compliance verification of GLP-regulated activities, including review of study plans, reports, relevant SOPs and documentation from internal areas and external CROs.

• Plan and conduct study-based and process-based internal inspections, including Good Clinical Laboratory Practice (GCLP) activities where relevant.

• Support stakeholders on GLP requirements and general quality matters, including review of GLP action plans from internal and external audits.

• Contribute to maintaining and improving the department’s QMS, including harmonisation, digitalisation and simplification initiatives.

• Communicate observations, regulatory requirements and practical quality recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders, and take part in relevant projects, audits and regulatory inspections.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Non-Clinical Quality, a diverse team of 15 skilled colleagues in Søborg. It is one of two sister departments within Process Management, Non-Clinical, IT & AI Quality, part of R&D Quality. In R&D, curiosity, data, collaboration and operational excellence come together to advance scientific ideas towards clinical testing, and Non-Clinical Quality helps make sure the processes behind that work are fit for purpose.

The team provides QMS expertise to a global organisation and works closely with stakeholders across the value chain. You will have many interfaces: research and laboratory colleagues in internal areas, external CROs and other collaboration partners, and teams across the organisation working on improvement projects.

You will work in an international environment where clear communication helps you build trust, create clarity around requirements and keep work moving. Some travel may be required for audits and other GLP QA activities.

Your impact begins here

As Senior Data Engineer, you will build the data foundations that bring Supply Chain AI Solutions to life. You will turn complex requirements into scalable, compliant, production-ready data products and pipelines that power strategic AI use cases for the Supply Chain organisation. Working hands-on in Databricks, you will help move ideas into reliable operation, supporting resilient supply chains and the delivery of treatment to millions of people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You bring strong production delivery experience and the ability to lead the data engineering side of an AI use case, from idea to reliable operation.

• 
A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.

• 
At least 8 years of experience in data engineering, including 3+ years in a senior role.

• 
Deep expertise in Azure Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows and Databricks SQL.

• 
Strong proficiency in Python, Apache Spark and SQL, with proven experience designing and building scalable, production-ready data pipelines and data products.

• 
A solid understanding of BI concepts, dimensional modelling, report and semantic layers, data integrations and self-service data platforms.

• 
Hands-on experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, coding best practices and agile ways of working such as Scrum.

• 
Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders and colleagues at different levels of the organisation.

You are technically curious and enjoy building data products that make a real difference. You are structured, take ownership, drive direction and inspire others to keep improving, and you stay on top of the latest trends in data engineering and AI.

Useful, but not essential:

• 
A Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Professional) certification or another relevant data engineering or cloud certification.

• 
Familiarity with Azure and AWS cloud services.

• 
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.

What you’ll do

You will set the critical path for Data Engineering within the delivery team to ensure we deliver reliable, production-ready products for our use cases, while sharing your expertise and support team members in adopting best practices. This includes being a hands-on technical contributor who is comfortable in taking the lead in building the required data products for use case from the early phase all the way to production.

• 
Design and implement data and model pipelines in Databricks, using Unity Catalog for governance and medallion architecture patterns to organise and serve reliable data.

• 
Apply an AI-first engineering mindset to create robust, scalable data foundations that are ready for future AI-driven manufacturing and supply chain use cases.

• 
Work hands-on across the full engineering lifecycle, from data modelling and pipeline development to testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.

• 
Build high-quality data products and pipelines within our established Databricks platform and engineering framework, with a focus on performance, cost efficiency, governance, compliance and maintainability

• 
Turn complex requirements into clear engineering priorities, identifying the critical path and making pragmatic decisions about what to solve now, what to simplify and what to develop further over time

• 
Mentor and develop data engineers through design sparring, code reviews and practical coaching.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will spend the majority of your time designing, building and improving solutions, while also providing technical guidance to less experienced engineers. You will work closely with the Lead Data Engineer and other senior technical colleagues, contributing to engineering direction while focusing on turning that direction into high-quality, working solutions.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Enterprise AI within Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology and high quality. Your team is Supply Chain AI Solutions: a small, end-to-end team where data scientists and engineers work side by side, combining analytical depth with the engineering capability to bring solutions into production.

Your closest colleagues are the Tech Lead, the Lead Data Scientist and the AI Product Owner. You will also collaborate with engineers, architects, data scientists and business stakeholders in the Supply Chain organisation, acting as a senior technical contributor across teams. Together, you will make clear decisions, keep delivery moving and turn practical needs into better operational decisions.

The team is cloud-native, working with platforms such as Databricks, Azure and AWS. It values agility, diverse thinking and continuous learning, and its culture is built on feedback, honesty and fun. The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take ownership, share your voice and shape how data engineering is built within Supply Chain AI Solutions. You will keep growing through continuous learning and career development, working on AI use cases at the forefront of technology, alongside colleagues who raise the bar with you.
